expected_outcomes: Flags that Sync() runs while holding the bus mutex, so every publisher and every fan-out serializes behind disk latency and tail latency compounds at 500 msg/s
Challenges the PR's 0.1 ms figure as an unmeasured claim: fsync latency varies widely by device, filesystem, and queue depth, and p99 not the mean is what the budget constrains
Proposes mitigations such as group commit or batching syncs on an interval, moving the WAL write outside the lock or to a dedicated goroutine, or making durability opt-in per topic
Requires a measurement: a load test at 500 msg/s reporting p50/p99/p99.9 publish latency on the target storage, before and after
Does not simply approve or simply reject without evidence
